title: Circulation of a Vortex Vector Field
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Compute the circulation of the vortex field F = <-y/(x^2 + y^2), x/(x^2 + y^2)> counterclockwise around a circle of radius R centered at the origin.

steps.title: Parametrize Circle of Radius R
steps.mathExpression: x = R\cos t, \; y = R\sin t \implies x^2 + y^2 = R^2; \quad dx = -R\sin t \, dt, \; dy = R\cos t \, dt

steps.title: Evaluate Differential Form
steps.mathExpression: M \, dx + N \, dy = \left( -\frac{R\sin t}{R^2} \right)(-R\sin t \, dt) + \left( \frac{R\cos t}{R^2} \right)(R\cos t \, dt) = (\sin^2 t + \cos^2 t) \, dt = 1 \, dt
steps.explanation: The factor R^2 cancels completely from numerator and denominator.

steps.title: Integrate over [0, 2*pi]
steps.explanation: Evaluate the integral of 1 over full circle.
